entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.447 of 2023, pending before the Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Keonjhar, arising out of Keonjhar Town P.S. Case No.172 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 419/420 of IPC.
3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (Vig), Keonjhar, by order dated 17.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. Perused the order of rejection and keeping in view the criminal antecedent as noted by the learned Court in seisin, this Court is not inclined to entertain this bail application during currency of investigation.
5. The petitioner is at liberty to move the learned Court below after filing of charge sheet.
The same shall be considered on its own merits without being influenced by the earlier rejection or the order passed by this Court.
6. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
